rows.note: Use 大細 for the overall physical dimensions or magnitude of something.

example.english: The size of this table is just right.
example.jyutping: nei1 zoeng1 toi4 ge3 daai6 sai3 ngaam1 ngaam1 hou2

rows.note: Use 碼 for a numbered or lettered clothing or shoe size, especially in ordinary shopping talk.

example.english: Do these shoes come in size 42?
example.jyutping: nei1 deoi3 haai4 jau5 mou5 sei3 sap6 ji6 maa5

rows.note: Use the colloquial loanword 晒士 when referring to a garment or shoe size in retail-style conversation.

example.jyutping: nei1 gin6 lau1 hai6 me1 saai1 si2
